subject: Brighthelm: CAIQ walk-through + staggered log extraction sessions
messages:
From: Tom Berger <t.berger@brighthelm.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Reyes <alicia.reyes@brighthelm.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Brighthelm — CAIQ walk-through + log extract windows

Hi Tessa / Ben,

Thanks for taking this on — we’re starting the CAIQ/SIG scoping for Brighthelm and would like to schedule a short walk-through of Redwood’s responses and also arrange a window to get sample telemetry/log exports for our security team to validate retention and redaction behavior.

Two asks from our side:
- 45–60 minute CAIQ call to review answers and call out a couple of clarifications (we’ll bring our security architect).
- One or two short sessions (20–30 min) to coordinate a controlled log extract / sample (S3 presigned or equivalent) — our InfoSec needs a small set of request/response logs and inference audit logs covering a few example flows.

Preferred weeks: May 3–7 OR May 10–14 (we can be flexible on days). Timezone: PDT.

I attached our baseline question list (brighthelm_caiq_questions.xlsx) to speed the prep. Let us know who from your side should own the extraction and whether a dedicated engineer should join.

Cheers,
Tom Berger
Senior Information Security Manager
Brighthelm Health
attachments: brighthelm_caiq_questions.xlsx
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Berger <t.berger@brighthelm.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brighthelm — CAIQ walk-through + log extract windows

Tom — thanks for the clear asks and the spreadsheet. We can cover both during a short two-part engagement: 1) CAIQ review (45m) and 2) staggered extraction sessions (2 x 25m). Staggering helps us scope exports without a big blast of data and gives your team time to validate samples.

Proposed plan (PDT):
- CAIQ walk-through: Tue May 4, 09:30–10:15 (PDT) — Marissa (Redwood security lead) + Ben to run the overview.
- Extraction session A (dev export + redaction check): Wed May 5, 11:00–11:30 — David to run extraction and provide presigned S3 link.
- Extraction session B (inference audit + token-level trace sample): Fri May 7, 14:00–14:30 — David + security engineer on call for questions.

If those times don’t work we can flip to week of May 10. For the extraction sessions we’ll need:
- The specific user/request flows you want captured (list of endpoints or example prompts).
- Target date ranges (max 72-hour window for the first sample; we can expand for a second sample).
- Any fields you want redacted in the sample (we’ll redact PII by default; confirm if you want additional masking).

I attached our internal runbook for exports (redwood_log_export_runbook.pdf) — it lists formats, retention truncation, and time-to-presigned-link. David, can you confirm the presigned S3 TTL and whether we should provide a gzipped JSONL.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_log_export_runbook.pdf
From: Tom Berger <t.berger@brighthelm.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Reyes <alicia.reyes@brighthelm.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brighthelm — CAIQ walk-through + log extract windows

Tessa — those slots look good; we’ll take May 4 for the CAIQ and both extraction sessions as proposed. A couple quick clarifications from our InfoSec lead (Alicia):
1) For the inference audit dump: can you confirm which identifiers are included? We want request IDs, model version, timestamp, and a hashed user_id (not raw).
2) Presigned link TTL: minimum 72 hours is fine; can you do 7 days? Our analysts may take a bit longer.
3) For redaction: please remove email addresses and credit-card-like patterns; we’ll mark any additional fields after the first sample.

Also, can you provide a short list of expected artifacts (logs, config snapshots, CAIQ export PDF) so I can raise the intake ticket on our side?

Thanks — Tom

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Follow-up: confirmed slots + action items (Brighthelm CAIQ + extract plan)

Thanks all — confirmed:
- CAIQ walk-through: Tue May 4, 09:30–10:15 (PDT) — meeting invite sent.
- Extraction A: Wed May 5, 11:00–11:30 (PDT).
- Extraction B: Fri May 7, 14:00–14:30 (PDT).

Action items (owner / due):
1) David Kim: prepare export run (gzipped JSONL), generate presigned S3 links (7-day TTL), redact emails and CCNs — deliver sample link during Extraction A. (Due: May 5 start)
2) Marissa Cole: lead CAIQ walk-through, annotate answers with any compensating controls and link to SOC 2 report excerpt. (Due: May 3 prep)
3) Ben Carter: coordinate logistics on scheduling and send invite to Brighthelm InfoSec distribution. (Due: Apr 26)
4) Brighthelm (Tom / Alicia): provide list of example endpoints / prompts you want included and priority fields to redact. (Due: May 3)

Artifacts we’ll deliver:
- CAIQ export (PDF) and annotated answers
- gzipped JSONL logs (inference_audit.jsonl.gz)
- request/response trace sample (traces.jsonl.gz)
- redwood_log_export_runbook.pdf (how exports are produced)

Attachments: sample-presigned-s3-link.txt (placeholder URL), redwood_log_export_runbook.pdf

If anything needs to shift, flag here and we’ll reprioritize. Looking forward to the call.

—
Tessa Morgan
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.com
